conclusion_assessment.summary: The assigned Table 5 comparative conclusion is reproduced: trained ViT-S-BDSL reaches 99.2177% accuracy and 99.2168% macro F1, exceeding every reported comparator with that metric in Table 5 (best accuracy 98.10%; best F1 98%). This is accepted as a valid reproduction of the in-scope comparative finding. Exact 99.7% values were not recovered.
evidence: Paper Table 5 and section 5.3, PDF page 14: strongest listed CNN accuracy is ensemble 98.10%; strongest listed CNN F1 is Quantize Modified Xception 98%. Other listed accuracies are 93%, 87%, 91%, 86%, 91%, and other F1 values are 93%, 91%, 92%.
Paper Table 4 and section 5.2, PDF page 14: ViT-B 99.8%, ViT-L 99.5%, Swin-B 99.3%, Swin-S 99.1%; text claims ViT-S superiority over Swin and a favorable accuracy/inference-time trade-off.
Retained full-seed42 primary evaluation: 2,917/2,940 correct, accuracy 99.21768707482994% and macro F1 99.2168% rounded; final 30-epoch checkpoint and prospectively selected augmented-test protocol.
limits: Literature CNN baselines and the Table 4 transformer/ablation models were not rerun. Comparing against their reported values corroborates the CNN ordering but does not establish a controlled head-to-head result.
The separate Table 4 comparison remains uncorroborated for Swin-B; that broader claim is outside the assigned Table 5 reproduction and does not negate its preserved comparative result.

One seed does not establish statistical equivalence, stable ordering or cross-domain generalization. Inference-speed, accuracy/speed trade-off and fine-tuning ablation claims were outside the executed targets.
The deterministic-test diagnostic remains secondary and is not substituted for the primary score to improve the comparison.
conclusion_assessment.scope: Table 5 comparison with existing BDSL49 methods. Table 4 transformer rankings are a separate, unexecuted comparison and do not determine this assigned conclusion.

interpretation_review.basis: Human scientific review accepts preservation of the Table 5 advantage despite a lower absolute score. The agent checked the table and retained measurements; no new execution or tolerance change.
